posts.name: B R GIRI SUBRAHMANYA
posts.cooked:
1. Is WSL allowed while oppe?
  2. Will there be any help manual available?
  3. Anything else to know before oppe?

Kindly let us know

posts.name: Shramadeep Debnath
posts.cooked:
@sayan @Subendu can u please clarify whether man command is allowed during oppe or not

And what other things are not allowed

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
1. You can ssh from anywhere, be it powershell, cmd, or wsl. WSL is not required as you can directly ssh from windows powershell or cmd, however it is not disallowed. Just ensure your public key from wherever you are ssh-ing is already uploaded to se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in. (yes, WSL and cmd have different public keys).

  2. All the man and info pages will be available as usual, simply run info sed or any other command and see the output.

    Screenshot 2024-12-07 at 4.01.01 PM784×224 177 KB

    Screenshot 2024-12-07 at 4.01.13 PM1630×1228 164 KB

    You can open each page of the info pages and read everything about the command. This is how you learn about a command. man pages also work as usual.
    Screenshot 2024-12-07 at 4.01.49 PM1628×1240 182 KB

    Screenshot 2024-12-07 at 4.02.00 PM750×142 132 KB

  3. You can watch the videos on tmux and OPPE Tips and Tricks at https://www.youtube.com/@BSSE2001/videos to increase your productivity. The questions will be present in same directory as always (/opt/se2001).

    Screenshot 2024-12-07 at 4.08.56 PM718×266 176 KB

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
anything you can do in a VM is allowed, except internet connectivity, so tldr may not work.

man and info will work.
